mechanisms.BLOCK: can't be talked out of — settings deny; hooks that exit 2 or emit decision:"block"
mechanisms.ASK: human gate per action — settings ask
mechanisms.DETECT: surfaces invisible state, never stops the action — non-blocking hooks
mechanisms.INSTRUCT: always-on prose the model follows — rules/*.md, skill doctrine
mechanisms.ROUTE: thin pointer to where content lives — CLAUDE.md rows, skill descriptions
mechanisms.VERIFY: computed audit of the other five — audit scripts, registries

system-safety.prevents: irreversible damage to the machine or the repository

cost-control.prevents: runaway spend on metered services and usage quotas

decision-gating-business.prevents: building the wrong thing (a check that each plan names its intended outcome)

decision-gating-technical.prevents: building the thing wrong (no rollback, unverified claims, false completion, an unreviewed build plan)

skill-governance.prevents: skill rot: skills that change without anyone noticing, skills that never trigger, and skills nothing checks automatically

content-lifecycle.prevents: ungoverned content accumulation: stale notes, corrections noted but never acted on, unclosed follow-ups

observe.prevents: nothing: a telemetry band, not counted among the protective domains; also a legal module domain

all.prevents: cross-cutting VERIFY and ROUTE artifacts (the audit module, the registry itself, the CLAUDE.md pointer kernel)

template.prevents: nothing: a copy-and-rename skeleton the repo owner fills in
